scenario: gate 与旧 bootstrap 的隔离
environment: Xcode 27.0 / iOS 27.0 SDK; iPhone 17 Simulator, UDID 555E35FA-6BFE-45F0-BCFC-0819FFE48CD2; Debug executable SHA-256 f937ceb39b8579565a7efa17e0044099046ce29e36ab640e34a89c6a7f4f642a; Release executable SHA-256 69600fa7f493020ab902aae8bb594496318e5f458a723a07bd408d6c10a1aed8
launch_arguments: not applicable to this row's static evidence; runtime confirmation is cross-referenced from A2/A3 (same commit, same binaries)
method: static source citation, not runtime capture. Every claim below names an exact file/line in the current commit; no inference from memory.

findings.claim: buildChannel is a compile-time constant (#if DEBUG / #else), never read from CommandLine.arguments, ProcessInfo.processInfo.arguments, or UserDefaults
findings.evidence:
iOS/AppDelegate.swift lines 70-74: `#if DEBUG
let buildChannel: Babel2BuildChannel = .debug
#else
let buildChannel: Babel2BuildChannel = .release
#endif`. No other assignment to a local named buildChannel exists in this file.

findings.claim: Babel2FeatureGate.decision(buildChannel:) ignores its own buildChannel parameter and all process/launch/persisted state; it is a pure constant function
findings.evidence: iOS/Babel2/Babel2FeatureGate.swift lines 827-835: the entire body is `Babel2FeatureGateDecision(generation: .babel2, reason: .babel2OnlyRuntime, diagnostics: ["single Babel2 runtime; launch arguments ignored"])` — the buildChannel parameter is never referenced inside the function body, and no CommandLine/ProcessInfo/UserDefaults symbol appears anywhere in this file.
findings.verify_by: grep -n 'CommandLine\|ProcessInfo.processInfo.arguments\|UserDefaults' iOS/Babel2/Babel2FeatureGate.swift  (expect no matches tied to the decision function)

findings.claim: the gate decision runs before any other side effect in the process, at AppDelegate.init()
findings.evidence: iOS/AppDelegate.swift lines 63-87: `override init()` computes processEntryUptime/gateUptime/launchDecision/recorder as the first statements, then calls `super.init()`, then `startBabel2LifecycleIfNeeded()`. No code runs before this init.
findings.verify_by: 打开 iOS/AppDelegate.swift，搜索 override init()，确认 launchDecision 的赋值是这个方法里最早的语句之一

findings.claim: startBabel2LifecycleIfNeeded()/bootstrapBabel2RuntimeIfNeeded() (the only lifecycle/bootstrap methods called from init/didFinishLaunching) reference zero legacy types
findings.evidence: iOS/AppDelegate.swift lines 96-116: the two methods call only AppDefaults.registerDefaults(), AccountManager.shared.start(), NotificationCenter observer registration, FaviconGenerator, ArticleThemesManager.shared.start(), NetworkMonitor.shared.start(), registerBackgroundTasks(), DefaultFeedsImporter, UNUserNotificationCenter — none of these are legacy UI/storyboard/coordinator/WebView types.

findings.claim: configurationForConnecting always returns the Babel2 scene configuration; there is no branch on scene session name, launch options, or any other input
findings.evidence: iOS/AppDelegate.swift lines 118-126: `application(_:configurationForConnecting:options:)` unconditionally returns `Babel2SceneConfiguration.makeBabel2(for: connectingSceneSession.role)` and records the selection; no conditional statement precedes the return.
findings.verify_by: 打开 iOS/AppDelegate.swift，搜索 configurationForConnecting，确认方法体里只有一次 return，没有 if/switch 分支

runtime_cross_reference: A2/A3 (this same commit) launched both the Debug and Release binaries above 5 times each with different launch argument combinations (no-args, -GenesisV2, -Babel2, an unknown flag, and a -Babel2/-GenesisV2 conflict) and captured the real Babel2LaunchTraceRecorder output via OSLog for every run. All 10 runs report generation=babel-2, legacyLifecycleStarted=false, legacyBootstrapStarted=false, legacyStoryboardInstantiations=0, legacyCoordinatorCreations=0, legacyWebViewBootstrapCalls=0. See A2-build-channel-matrix.json for the full per-run data. This is runtime confirmation of the static claims above, not a substitute for them.
observed: 所有静态引用均在当前 commit 中核实过；没有发现任何分支能让 buildChannel、launch arguments 或 persisted 状态改变 generation，也没有发现旧生命周期/bootstrap/storyboard/coordinator/WebView 类型出现在生产初始化路径里。
limitations: 本行只覆盖 AppDelegate.swift/SceneDelegate.swift/Babel2FeatureGate.swift 三个文件的静态引用与已有 A2/A3 runtime 交叉证据；不覆盖 target membership、resource bundle allowlist（A15 范围）或目标物理 iPhone。
